description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_AssignByRef, which implements a method to assign variables by reference within the Smarty templating engine. It contains the assignByRef method that assigns a value to a template variable by reference, updating scope if necessary.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_AssignByRef
classes.description: Class implementing a method to assign template variables by reference in Smarty.

methods.name: assignByRef
methods.description: Assigns a value to a Smarty template variable by reference, with optional cache control and scope update.
